Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 34, "heading": "CHAPTER 32. THE BEGINNING OF A LONG JOURNEY", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u034-b0030", "target": "— Нет, нет, Дэн, — отозвалась она, — этого не будет. Обо мне не заботься. У меня будет довольно дела — сохранять для тебя Бытиё, — (миссис Гаммидж имела в виду дом), — к твоему возвращению; сохранять здесь Бытиё для всякого, кто, может статься, вернётся, Дэн. В погожее время я буду сидеть за дверью, как привыкла. Если кто станет подходить, пусть издали увидят старую вдовушку, верную им.", "source_sha256": "94822bde584030aa7fc3b1ac702123e775721ba6204c25266642a34acf65ae44", "target_id": "ru-en85-u034-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8981fa6e52811d42facb5d9b798c9d0afa639cb5c2d5557d1a6ee9ee4cc50983"}, {"source_id": "en85-u034-b0031", "target": "Какая перемена в миссис Гаммидж за столь короткое время! Она стала другой женщиной. Она была так самоотверженна, она так чутко понимала, что хорошо сказать и что хорошо оставить несказанным; она так забыла о себе и так бережно относилась к горю вокруг, что я проникся к ней чем-то вроде благоговения. А сколько работы она сделала в тот день! Многое нужно было поднять с берега и сложить в сарае — вёсла, сети, паруса, снасти, мачты и шесты, верши для омаров, мешки с балластом и тому подобное; и хотя помощи было вдоволь, поскольку на всём этом берегу не нашлось бы ни одной пары рабочих рук, которые не потрудились бы изо всех сил для мистера Пегготи и не сочли бы себя щедро вознаграждёнными самой просьбой, она упорно весь день надрывалась под тяжестями, ей совершенно не по силам, и бегала взад и вперёд по всяким ненужным поручениям. Что до сетований на свои несчастья, она, казалось, совершенно утратила память о том, что у неё когда-либо были несчастья. Она сохраняла ровную бодрость посреди своего сочувствия, и это было не самой малой из удивительных сторон той перемены, что с ней произошла. О нытье не могло быть и речи. Я не заметил, чтобы голос её дрогнул или слеза выкатилась из её глаз за целый день, вплоть до сумерек; тогда, когда мы остались вместе, она, я и мистер Пегготи, а он заснул от полного изнеможения, она разразилась полуподавленными рыданиями и слезами и, подведя меня к двери, сказала: «Благослови вас Бог, мистер Дэви, будьте ему другом, бедняжке дорогому!» Затем она тотчас выбежала из дома умыть лицо, чтобы потом спокойно сидеть подле него и быть застигнутой за работой, когда он проснётся. Словом, я оставил её, уходя вечером, опорой и посохом в горе мистера Пегготи, и не мог довольно размышлять об уроке, который я прочёл в миссис Гаммидж, и о новом опыте, который она мне открыла.", "source_sha256": "eea41d2dbdf240297aefcf09599f0b6d84dba70ae17ed3f662b7f791efcde5cf", "target_id": "ru-en85-u034-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "85f3bdf576640faaa7edea3457daabee57794727bb11bd57ae5a349b2817b8d0"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 32, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u034-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was between nine and ten o’clock when, strolling in a melancholy manner through the town, I stopped at Mr. Omer’s door. Mr. Omer had taken it so much to heart, his daughter told me, that he had been very low and poorly all day, and had gone to bed without his pipe.", "sha256": "0d5d397e14ba9e18e6bf9aefaef8cef32395cf9097b5f1e02c26c427f4fc5215", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A deceitful, bad-hearted girl,’ said Mrs. Joram. ‘There was no good in her, ever!’", "sha256": "f2c8fb1d6a874d733fcabac9e9e8863dc16edefadd347c3ce1a6777f64003544", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Don’t say so,’ I returned. ‘You don’t think so.’", "sha256": "fe82549cc529567af3d3c4d505bc076b6b3ce7664620803a27f6c67a014d90a7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, I do!’ cried Mrs. Joram, angrily.", "sha256": "ac4d37bcf1d9c09b0763ff5bc39cdd79926eeb5f4028c914b45422de9771d371", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, no,’ said I.", "sha256": "da99695b8c1934ca6c0232ca0e7727802d747f8747eba49606c78dba4adfd541", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mrs. Joram tossed her head, endeavouring to be very stern and cross; but she could not command her softer self, and began to cry. I was young, to be sure; but I thought much the better of her for this sympathy, and fancied it became her, as a virtuous wife and mother, very well indeed.", "sha256": "9008af3b42d5cc74b50b001c9ff326c5fa3b79f9455c041604d08e5e50ffa18b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What will she ever do!’ sobbed Minnie. ‘Where will she go! What will become of her! Oh, how could she be so cruel, to herself and him!’", "sha256": "7fee39745a76988dc4001fa43410f6ec1d95127e18414ac19522930d395b815c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I remembered the time when Minnie was a young and pretty girl; and I was glad she remembered it too, so feelingly.", "sha256": "c09ec69d4259205bc4982bc648ceb45398b81870d4078acbe890eabb1024d700", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My little Minnie,’ said Mrs. Joram, ‘has only just now been got to sleep. Even in her sleep she is sobbing for Em’ly. All day long, little Minnie has cried for her, and asked me, over and over again, whether Em’ly was wicked? What can I say to her, when Em’ly tied a ribbon off her own neck round little Minnie’s the last night she was here, and laid her head down on the pillow beside her till she was fast asleep! The ribbon’s round my little Minnie’s neck now. It ought not to be, perhaps, but what can I do? Em’ly is very bad, but they were fond of one another. And the child knows nothing!’", "sha256": "585800bf98c19a73a3878eadeb0180b5a66e1374fe9426d0a96c9d7299b0215c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mrs. Joram was so unhappy that her husband came out to take care of her. Leaving them together, I went home to Peggotty’s; more melancholy myself, if possible, than I had been yet.", "sha256": "c168d0f33e026612b00e1676bad0dc29ff6884a6c2f17e27e26205171eb995e2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "That good creature—I mean Peggotty—all untired by her late anxieties and sleepless nights, was at her brother’s, where she meant to stay till morning. An old woman, who had been employed about the house for some weeks past, while Peggotty had been unable to attend to it, was the house’s only other occupant besides myself. As I had no occasion for her services, I sent her to bed, by no means against her will, and sat down before the kitchen fire a little while, to think about all this.", "sha256": "cfaee924eba502f731fd02997c534ec890d017cc3b2e46857914a1b0dd1e7d1e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was blending it with the deathbed of the late Mr. Barkis, and was driving out with the tide towards the distance at which Ham had looked so singularly in the morning, when I was recalled from my wanderings by a knock at the door. There was a knocker upon the door, but it was not that which made the sound. The tap was from a hand, and low down upon the door, as if it were given by a child.", "sha256": "e7f0d48b080713ca1995ef6d9999588b49f877c6d8c5e8f70012511043400a15", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It made me start as much as if it had been the knock of a footman to a person of distinction. I opened the door; and at first looked down, to my amazement, on nothing but a great umbrella that appeared to be walking about of itself. But presently I discovered underneath it, Miss Mowcher.", "sha256": "432094199940be6a70ab0fca08ee1546703427c36d8082e679493b4156fa627f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I might not have been prepared to give the little creature a very kind reception, if, on her removing the umbrella, which her utmost efforts were unable to shut up, she had shown me the ‘volatile’ expression of face which had made so great an impression on me at our first and last meeting. But her face, as she turned it up to mine, was so earnest; and when I relieved her of the umbrella (which would have been an inconvenient one for the Irish Giant), she wrung her little hands in such an afflicted manner; that I rather inclined towards her.", "sha256": "9ce2b6c1bc8cbbea736c2a924e3ef32d1fc5bd0c4a70f1aa4bdaa5a6bc74bb79", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Miss Mowcher!’ said I, after glancing up and down the empty street, without distinctly knowing what I expected to see besides; ‘how do you come here? What is the matter?’ She motioned to me with her short right arm, to shut the umbrella for her; and passing me hurriedly, went into the kitchen. When I had closed the door, and followed, with the umbrella in my hand, I found her sitting on the corner of the fender—it was a low iron one, with two flat bars at top to stand plates upon—in the shadow of the boiler, swaying herself backwards and forwards, and chafing her hands upon her knees like a person in pain.", "sha256": "837052f8af72675798f6777e4ed50b770afe33a250565fdc4a25985ac20caab7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Quite alarmed at being the only recipient of this untimely visit, and the only spectator of this portentous behaviour, I exclaimed again, ‘Pray tell me, Miss Mowcher, what is the matter! are you ill?’", "sha256": "9da36a042f3c4176314e41b7a7e9c2fd7cb1d6ee5361403e48ef915b2cedceeb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My dear young soul,’ returned Miss Mowcher, squeezing her hands upon her heart one over the other. ‘I am ill here, I am very ill. To think that it should come to this, when I might have known it and perhaps prevented it, if I hadn’t been a thoughtless fool!’", "sha256": "bdeef602b2695668a1dfd6bb60e87fed335e0587a07e0623958bcba36fd51ca8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Again her large bonnet (very disproportionate to the figure) went backwards and forwards, in her swaying of her little body to and fro; while a most gigantic bonnet rocked, in unison with it, upon the wall.", "sha256": "c1f39b22d7190306a095b44fc29dae4858e44350c276cf702f23d9a194710393", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am surprised,’ I began, ‘to see you so distressed and serious’—when she interrupted me.", "sha256": "0f51f50844ceb5cfec1389c7837e158445ea0c32a3053837cd568908b119dd5b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, it’s always so!’ she said. ‘They are all surprised, these inconsiderate young people, fairly and full grown, to see any natural feeling in a little thing like me! They make a plaything of me, use me for their amusement, throw me away when they are tired, and wonder that I feel more than a toy horse or a wooden soldier! Yes, yes, that’s the way. The old way!’", "sha256": "760936b710dd5a260b736192d61cfd0d0c47724e45c809ce5102b66f887d3dff", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It may be, with others,’ I returned, ‘but I do assure you it is not with me. Perhaps I ought not to be at all surprised to see you as you are now: I know so little of you. I said, without consideration, what I thought.’", "sha256": "9673dd95227db2ecc81ff3e58604d607c532f2740851ce3e5c7f3cfbeaf5c9b0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What can I do?’ returned the little woman, standing up, and holding out her arms to show herself. ‘See! What I am, my father was; and my sister is; and my brother is. I have worked for sister and brother these many years—hard, Mr. Copperfield—all day. I must live. I do no harm. If there are people so unreflecting or so cruel, as to make a jest of me, what is left for me to do but to make a jest of myself, them, and everything? If I do so, for the time, whose fault is that? Mine?’", "sha256": "f259747521724d415daae1c7c2e7f81a3550667b6cb01394eae4a2f30aa8f830", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "No. Not Miss Mowcher’s, I perceived.", "sha256": "38150d68585472ed6af4dcfcf10d798455fec4d47c1447356ff99c28c0de759f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If I had shown myself a sensitive dwarf to your false friend,’ pursued the little woman, shaking her head at me, with reproachful earnestness, ‘how much of his help or good will do you think I should ever have had? If little Mowcher (who had no hand, young gentleman, in the making of herself) addressed herself to him, or the like of him, because of her misfortunes, when do you suppose her small voice would have been heard? Little Mowcher would have as much need to live, if she was the bitterest and dullest of pigmies; but she couldn’t do it. No. She might whistle for her bread and butter till she died of Air.’", "sha256": "58fadc475ca4c0dab4a5e5b6ee6729b6cd0c99dae83075a46fb6bf4aab96e976", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Mowcher sat down on the fender again, and took out her handkerchief, and wiped her eyes.", "sha256": "6e76fb51b68ae336b4b6ae6e4b6f0232373ca4a4beeeafee884c18553bb7d8ac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Be thankful for me, if you have a kind heart, as I think you have,’ she said, ‘that while I know well what I am, I can be cheerful and endure it all. I am thankful for myself, at any rate, that I can find my tiny way through the world, without being beholden to anyone; and that in return for all that is thrown at me, in folly or vanity, as I go along, I can throw bubbles back. If I don’t brood over all I want, it is the better for me, and not the worse for anyone. If I am a plaything for you giants, be gentle with me.’", "sha256": "cf2d6f1976bfad8270afda08676322ffdd7015d21c526b0d4aa21b796a8bd1cc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Mowcher replaced her handkerchief in her pocket, looking at me with very intent expression all the while, and pursued:", "sha256": "edc58c871cc65a7bb1d5fb3875944e1b8a0a60bb9d12d45ced26688d8b3f1b2b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I saw you in the street just now. You may suppose I am not able to walk as fast as you, with my short legs and short breath, and I couldn’t overtake you; but I guessed where you came, and came after you. I have been here before, today, but the good woman wasn’t at home.’", "sha256": "bb184ffcc89388363622d46810215fc9793e2810deb775f5e011e0bdf4792538", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Do you know her?’ I demanded.", "sha256": "841d1d4fb8dc54f26c09f2bb37602b9b40337580bb07fcd3af9d8f251728efc8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I know of her, and about her,’ she replied, ‘from Omer and Joram. I was there at seven o’clock this morning. Do you remember what Steerforth said to me about this unfortunate girl, that time when I saw you both at the inn?’", "sha256": "dcf57f8d384c238f4bc4c86ae6eca4a0dd9000ea9c28ff70623529f840c6f1a5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The great bonnet on Miss Mowcher’s head, and the greater bonnet on the wall, began to go backwards and forwards again when she asked this question.", "sha256": "42fc0fd633d02aa67549b807394c4af09bd47709313a9a86106c36c08d3f2cca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I remembered very well what she referred to, having had it in my thoughts many times that day. I told her so.", "sha256": "be9b4f485500226abd3026b10fcc5051b8913e7a64103ccbead0eb6624e78a51", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
